{{dablink|For other uses of the word "gold," part of the meaning of Alcair Dal, see [[Gold]].}}
'''Alcair Dal''' is a meeting place for the [[Aiel]] clan chiefs. The name means "The Golden Bowl" in the [[Old Tongue]]. It is a round canyon that has excellent acoustics and it is located near [[Rhuidean]] and [[Cold Rocks Hold]].
